metadata.title: Tesla-SpaceX Merger: What the Marvell-Lumentum Backlash Tells Investors<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
What the Marvell-Lumentum Misfire Means for a Tesla-SpaceX Merger
It almost goes without saying: Tesla investors expect a merger with SpaceX, with the latter offering a premium in an all-stock deal. SpaceX might offer a 20% or 30% premium, pushing Tesla stock as high as $500.
